slice-a-registry-mode-model-author-glm-a.text: Eighteen tasks: definitions first, then the statements, the open application before naming, the regenerated corpora and manifests, the opened model checker, the three rewritten pages, and the four mutants with their controls.

slice-b-163-simulator-author-muse-audito.text: Nine tasks, starting only after the model slice's audit passes: the profiles, the named refusals, replay agreement, the journeys and their limits, the clarity record, the counts, the browser checks and fresh speech.

gate-held-not-a-task.text: The gate criteria are not checkboxes. Only the ticket gate, on the combined tree, may claim the repository green.
